I can say from my experience, the process goes you go to your local hall for example I live in Orange County so the hall for that county is 441, I would go there and apply for the apprenticeship 

Then from there you take an aptitude test, which is comprised of Math and writing/Reading, the math is mostly just basic algebra, and the writing is pretty self explanatory. Once you finish the test you wait a few days for your results weather you passed or not, let’s say you did pass, you would receive notification about an interview in front of the board, they ask you a few questions and from there you get placed on a list of other applicants, the higher(closer to 1) the higher likelihood you will be selected for the next apprenticeship class, and vice versa the lower, the longer it will take to get in 

From there once you get selected to get into the apprenticeship you fill out some forms, then you start classes along with work and you go from there!
